_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
events.desc: Gavrilo Princip shoots the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne in Sarajevo.

events.label: Austria-Hungary declares war on Serbia
events.desc: The declaration that turns the July Crisis into war.

events.label: Germany invades Belgium; Britain declares war
events.desc: German troops cross the Belgian border and Britain enters the war.

events.label: Battle of Tannenberg
events.desc: Germany destroys the Russian Second Army in East Prussia.

events.label: First Battle of the Marne
events.desc: French and British forces stop the German advance on Paris.

events.label: Second Battle of Ypres
events.desc: Germany uses chlorine gas on a large scale for the first time on the Western Front.

events.label: Gallipoli landings
events.desc: Allied troops land on the Gallipoli peninsula; they withdraw in January 1916.

events.label: Sinking of the Lusitania
events.desc: A German submarine sinks the liner off Ireland; 1,198 people die.

events.label: Italy enters the war
events.desc: Italy declares war on Austria-Hungary.

events.label: Battle of Verdun begins
events.desc: The longest battle of the war lasts until December.

events.label: Battle of Jutland
events.desc: The main British and German fleets meet in the North Sea.

events.label: Brusilov Offensive
events.desc: Russia's most successful offensive breaks the Austro-Hungarian front in Galicia.

events.label: Battle of the Somme begins
events.desc: The British army suffers its heaviest losses in a single day.

events.label: February Revolution
events.desc: Strikes and mutiny in Petrograd bring down the tsar, who abdicates a week later.

events.label: United States declares war on Germany
events.wiki: American entry into World War I
events.desc: Congress votes for war after unrestricted submarine warfare and the Zimmermann telegram.

events.label: October Revolution
events.desc: The Bolsheviks seize power in Petrograd.

events.label: Treaty of Brest-Litovsk
events.desc: Soviet Russia leaves the war and gives up vast western territories.

events.label: German spring offensive
events.desc: Germany's last attempt to win in the west before American troops arrive in strength.

events.label: Battle of Amiens
events.desc: The Allied attack that opens the Hundred Days Offensive.

events.label: Abdication of Wilhelm II
events.desc: The German republic is proclaimed in Berlin.

events.label: Armistice with Germany
events.desc: Fighting on the Western Front stops at 11 a.m.
